scripts.port:8081: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($p){$p | Format-Table -AutoSize} else {Write-Host 'No process found on port 8081'}; exit 0"
scripts.port:3000: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($p){$p | Format-Table -AutoSize} else {Write-Host 'No process found on port 3000'}; exit 0"
scripts.kill:8081: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if($p){$p|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force}; Write-Host 'Killed processes on port 8081'} else {Write-Host 'No process found on port 8081'}"
scripts.kill:3000: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if($p){$p|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force}; Write-Host 'Killed processes on port 3000'} else {Write-Host 'No process found on port 3000'}"
scripts.kill:ports: npm run kill:8081 && npm run kill:3000
